events.title: Black Hollow is coming to Steam Next Fest! Play the free demo now
events.summary: Hey everyone! Black Hollow is taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19–26, and the free demo is available to play right now. Version 0.9 is also going live on October 19, alongside the start of Next Fest. Become Aldren, a lone plague doctor facing the infected in a first-person dark-fantasy horde-survival roguelite. Fight through escalating waves, harvest plague ichor, and combine upgrades to build something monstrous. https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/4880

events.title: Patch 0.3.0
events.summary: Black Hollow — Patch 0.3.0Ability LoadoutsAdded the Plague Shelf, where you can change your four-slot combat loadout during the day.Added Plague Flame, a widening surge of plague fire that ignites enemies and leaves burning ground.Added Plague Barrier, a cast-through ward that damages and violently repels enemies.Added Pestilent Burst, a high-damage flask that infects enemies and spreads contagion when they die.Added Leeching Vapors, a lingering flask cloud that drains health from enemies.Update

events.title: 200 Wishlists!
events.summary: Holy! Flew from 100 to 200 in no time. Keep pushing this out to friends who may like this product. I appreciate all of you! Thank you!

events.title: 100 Wishlists!
events.summary: Thank you all for helping Black Hollow reach 100 wishlists on Steam.I know that may seem small compared to bigger games, but as a solo developer, it genuinely means a lot. Every wishlist, demo download, comment, and bit of feedback helps push the game forward and keeps me motivated to keep improving it.There is still a lot I want to add and polish, but I’m really grateful for everyone who has checked it out so far.Thank you for supporting Black Hollow. The bell is only getting louder.
